Name: BFAV Shops by Asunai
Author: asunai2
Description:
[b]UPDATE:

There is now only one shop which is accessed from the main barrel.  This will be fine if you only have a few BFAV animals, however, if you have a ton of BFAV I recommend you get Fury's too many animals mod which adds a scroll bar to the animal menus so things will still look right. Again this will only  be an issue if you have over 30 animals in your game.

I've also added over 150 BFAV animals to the store. I will add more animals if I find anymore that I haven't already included or if anyone lets me know of one that's not already included.

The original mod is still available and can be used, but will not be updated further unless I get request for me to update the multiple stores version.

==================================

BFAV shops by Asunai[/b]

So I decided to install a ton of BFAV animals only to realize Marni's shop doesn't have a scroll bar or pages and the list got too long and I couldn't access all of the animals. [Fixed with Furys mod but my mod is still relevant for some purposes, see note on the bottom of page).  Therefore I moved all of the BFAV animals I could find into their own shops. My mod does not alter or touch any of the original files made by anyone else, it only adds  those animals to my shops so you can buy them from my shop instead of having to go through Marni's menu.

You will need to download all of the BFAV files you want on your own. If you do not have one of the BFAV supported files then the shop tile framework  will just ignore those files and not load them. The # of pages that show up in the shop (if using Fury's mod) will increase depending on the # of animals you have. If you don't have  Fury's mod then you will just see the animals added to the first page in the shop. Basically: The mod adapts to whatever you have for BFAV.

[s]Two shops are accessed through a barrel and one shop is accessed through the lamp at marni's desk. Additionally, you can buy all of the animals without Marnie needing to be present. I've also included the vanilla animals in shop # 3  (the shop that is accessed from the lamp post).[/s]
[b]
If you have BFAV mods that are NOT included in this mod or supported please let me know and I can add support for them in my shops.[/b]

[s]Right now there are 3 shops but I may add more over time.[/s] More BFAV animals will be added to the shops over time. You will need to download the animals from their mod pages, as this mod does not provide any animals - it only provides a shop for all animals that I could locate.


[b]Thank you to Nuztalgia for the assistance with the code. [/b]
[b]
NOTE:  I would recommend using my mod  with https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11033 mod if you want Marnie's menu to look nice as well. Him & I collaborated with these things so now Marnie's looks fantastic. My mod is still useful if you do *not* want to have to wait around for Marnie to tend her shop to buy animals or if you want to buy animals later then when her shop is open.

As of right now I am unable to remove animals from Marnie's menu so she will show the same animals as my shop has. If anyone can find a work around for this feel free to hit me up!

If you just want the vanilla experience and want to buy everything from Marnie, use above ^

To do:

I'll be making a version of this that adds to Alec's shop instead at some point. Mostly to give people variety in their choices!
